checks.Detail: All product IDs are unique; one row per source product
Retained as separate records; names alone do not establish duplicate formulas
Unicode NFC; invisible characters removed; repeated whitespace collapsed
Missing source ratings preserved as Unrated; no safety score imputed
Unknown concentration remains null, never zero
Image availability verified against images folder
Occurrences retained by source position; product reach uses distinct product IDs

rules: Original JSONL and empty CSV are unchanged
Do not merge product names or ingredient aliases without evidence
Tags describe supplied catalog labels; absent tag is not evidence of ingredient presence
Source ingredient ratings are annotations, not clinical evidence or product safety scores
No date, price, sales, review score or clinical outcome exists in this dataset
